meta.description: Infers ASVs from demultiplexed 16S or ITS amplicon FASTQ with cutadapt, DADA2, ITSxpress, per-run error models, post-merge chimera removal, and decontam.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated citation, measurement, or biological result was found; live fixture claims were checked against truth data.

practice_boundaries.detail: The Skill provides research-processing guidance and does not diagnose or prescribe for individuals.

methodological_ground.detail: Live runs confirmed the documented primer-first, per-run inference, merge-then-chimera, ITS variable-length, and control-based decontamination boundaries.

code_usability.detail: The shipped cutadapt and DADA2 scripts, ITSxpress branch, and all audit assertions executed. The optional QIIME2 Deblur example used valid flags but produced no artifact on two checked input artifacts; this is recorded as a P2 preflight gap, not evidence of an invalid command.

functional_suitability.note: Complete paths for V4, multi-run, ITS, decontamination, and QIIME2 equivalents are present.

reliability.note: Core paths have concrete failure modes and checks; the optional Deblur route lacks a no-surviving-read preflight.

performance_context.note: Clear per-run and truncation-budget guidance; full error-model fitting remains naturally compute-intensive.

agent_usability.note: Scenario decision tree, thresholds, and common-error remedies are specific and actionable.

human_usability.note: Scope routing and explanations distinguish operational choices from biological interpretation.

security.note: No credentials, unsafe execution pattern, or destructive data instruction was found.

maintainability.note: Both referenced examples exist and were executed; alternative QIIME2 coverage is intentionally concise.

agent_specific.note: Trigger description is precise, progressive disclosure is strong, and routes outside amplicon processing are explicit.

inputs.execution_note: Ran q2-deblur denoise-16S 2024.10 twice against two imported/real demultiplexed artifacts at 200 bp and 100 bp. Both actions executed through Deblur's reference-index stage but ended with q2-deblur's unhelpful max() arg is an empty sequence error and produced no output artifacts.
inputs.note: The documented command flags exist and execute, but this audit did not establish a successful Deblur output for the available inputs.

assertions.note: Both live actions started and reached Deblur processing.

key_strengths: The exact shipped V4 primer-removal and multi-run DADA2 examples run end-to-end on fresh data.
The documented post-primer truncLen ceiling is exactly reproduced at a one-base boundary.
Real ITSxpress ITS2 trimming now has live evidence rather than help-only evidence.
Controls-based decontamination and rejection of flat abundance cutoffs are both explicit and verified.

recommendations.title: Add a QIIME2 Deblur no-surviving-reads preflight
recommendations.problem: Two real/imported artifacts reached q2-deblur but produced no output and its error did not tell the user that no sequences survived the tool's processing.
recommendations.root_cause: The QIIME2 equivalent is a terse command without a read-length or post-filter survival diagnostic.
recommendations.fix: Before denoise-16S, direct users to inspect demux read lengths and verify a suitable trim length; after failure, inspect whether zero reads survive rather than treating the q2-deblur exception as a generic installation error.
